title: Sprint planning probes a new refusal against today's main, and map.csv maps tests.py and bl_base.py to querylog.md
goal: Answers the SP-vmxdxtru retrospective: ST-rbcr2tm6's goal, refuse a push while any open item's selector selects no test, would have refused every push of a test file on the day it was planned (ST-founcbvo's selector collects none), and BG-p3jphxgb's goal could not be met with the week in the finding key; both were gated only after the start. kb-sprint plan step 6 runs a committed item's new refusal or detector condition once against today's main and asks a gate before the start when it would fire now. And ST-d35ns45r's change made kb/_self/querylog.md false although selfdoc.py map named it for neither _tools/tests.py nor _tools/bl_base.py: kb/_self/map.csv maps both to querylog.md.
